slug: 2024-09-17 Rwanda conducts pilot to implement biometric SIM registration, verification

facts.fact: Biometric Update says Rwanda is digitizing its national ID system and in May 2024 received bids for a single digital ID core and support modules.
Biometric Update says NIDA holds fingerprint and face data against which people are matched, and each SIM is to be linked to the owner's unique identification number.
